intent: Add GET /tasks/count, a read-only aggregate endpoint returning HTTP 200 with the JSON object {"count": <integer>} where count is the total number of tasks currently in the store. It is a lightweight convenience for the dashboard: count must always equal the number of items returned by GET /tasks at the same moment, POST /tasks (201) increases it by exactly 1 and DELETE /tasks/{id} (204) decreases it by exactly 1. It introduces no authentication and no persistence-model change; the root health endpoint GET / and all existing /tasks CRUD behaviour are unchanged. The count is computed at the endpoint/query boundary over the existing store read API, so the store's public shape is not changed.
